turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping takes 1-3 business days for us to fulfill your order, plus an additional 4-8 business days for delivery. So, you can expect your order to arrive within 5-11 business days total. Most orders arrive on the quicker side, but we like to give a safe estimate just in case!

You can find all the details on our shipping information page if you’d like to take a look.

What's your return and refund policy?

Our return and refund policy is designed to be simple and stress-free:

Most unused, non-defective items can be returned for a full refund within 90 days of purchase, as long as they're unused and in their original packaging.
We don't accept returns on personalized or custom items, or certain limited edition products.
Orders shipped to Canada aren't eligible for returns.
If you return an item, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.
We don't process direct exchanges, but you're welcome to return and place a new order if needed.

You can read all the details or start a return on our Return Policy page. Let me know if you have any other questions!

You can reach our support team by emailing support@simplemodern.com or by using the contact form on our website. All support is handled through email—there’s no phone support, but our team works hard to respond as quickly as possible! Our normal hours are Monday–Thursday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM CST, and Friday, 8:30 AM – 12:00 PM CST. If you have an order issue, just send us the details and we’ll help you out!
